status: We have not solved P versus NP yet.
verification: Finite check audits and exact arithmetic self-reviewed; Lean 4 machine-checked formalizations for foundational complexity reductions; no formal or expert verification of a complete solution.
target: Resolve Cook/Clay Millennium P versus NP formulation: determine whether SAT is decidable in deterministic polynomial time.
remaining_obligations: Overcome the Relativization (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975), Natural Proofs (Razborov-Rudich 1997), and Algebrization (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) barriers.
Prove superpolynomial circuit lower bounds for an explicit function in NP against general non-uniform circuits (P/poly) or construct a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for 3-SAT.
Enforce standing exclusion: average-case SAT heuristics and restricted circuit models (monotone, AC0) cannot claim general P != NP separation.
